detailed_results.query: How does Kubernetes HPA calculate desired replicas?

naive.answer:
[Section: Kubernetes Pod Autoscaling Mechanics > HPA Scaling Formula]
The desired replica count is deterministically computed according to the following mathematical formula: desiredReplicas = ceil[currentReplicas * (currentMetricValue / desiredMetricValue)] [1] [Section: Kubernetes Pod Autoscaling Mechanics]
Kubernetes implements the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) to dynamically adjust pod replica counts based on observed CPU utilization, memory consumption, or custom Prometheus metrics. [2] [Section: Kubernetes Pod Autoscaling Mechanics > Stabilization and Flapping Prevention]
HPA queries the cluster Metrics Server periodically every 15 seconds. [3]
